talking_points.headline: HSBC's Elhedery confirms H2 stablecoin launch and a 'thoughtful' multi-model AI stance, days after the H1 beat
talking_points.context_html: In a fresh interview following HSBC's H1 2026 results, Georges Elhedery, Group CEO of HSBC said the bank is 'growing across all our indicators' and confirmed the HKD stablecoin — integrated into PayMe and the HSBC HK App — will launch in the second half of 2026, alongside a deliberately multi-model approach to AI investment. For Adam, both threads sit squarely inside his APAC AI-enabled change remit: the stablecoin is a live digital-payments delivery programme, and the multi-model AI stance signals how HSBC intends to avoid vendor lock-in as it scales agentic tools.

talking_points.headline: JPMorgan poaches a DBS private banker for Indonesia as the APAC talent war spreads
talking_points.context_html: JPMorgan Private Bank hired Aldrin Sudirgo, formerly Vice President at DBS Private Bank, to its Indonesia team, adding a 21-year veteran with stints at Standard Chartered, HSBC, Citigroup, UOB and Credit Suisse. It's a fresh instance of the cross-border private-banker talent war Adam has been tracking — following DBS's own hire of a Standard Chartered veteran for its India wealth team on 3 August — and a reminder that HSBC alumni are being actively recruited by rivals building out Southeast Asia coverage.

HSBC News.title: HSBC 'growing across all our indicators'
HSBC News.summary: In a fresh interview following HSBC's H1 2026 results (covered 4 August), CEO Georges Elhedery said the bank is 'growing across all our indicators' and confirmed the HKD stablecoin — integrated into PayMe and the HSBC HK App — will launch in the second half of 2026, alongside a deliberately multi-model approach to AI investment. The comments add new detail on stablecoin timing and AI vendor posture beyond the results and simplification-target coverage already reported this week.

Competitor Intelligence.title: JP Morgan Private Bank Hires DBS Private Bank's Aldrin Sudirgo as Vice President, Indonesia Team
Competitor Intelligence.summary: JPMorgan Private Bank hired Aldrin Sudirgo from DBS Private Bank as Vice President on its Indonesia team; Sudirgo brings 21 years of private banking experience spanning Standard Chartered, HSBC, Citigroup, UOB and Credit Suisse. The move follows DBS's own hire of a Standard Chartered veteran for its India wealth team, reported 3 August, extending the same cross-border private-banker talent war into a new market.
